problem.halo_pattern: 1D X-axis decomposition, halo to left + right neighbor

method: Time comm (rank 0), 3 runs each, median reported. Same compute node allocation across all runs to amortize cold-cache effects.

hip_gda_hipcc.description: GDA reference path — direct libfabric DWQ submission from device

hip_gicc_lto.description: GICC LTO pass pipeline (tools/gicc-passes/), default IPC_OR_DWQ hybrid lowering

v1_acceptance.notes: spec §2.6 target was median ≤ 92.5 ms (≤ 1.05× GDA). LTO median is 86.44 ms — 6.6% below the target and 2.1% FASTER than the GDA reference, exceeding the v1 acceptance bar.

command: GICC_MODE=lower GICC_META_DIR=/tmp/gicc-meta-baseline make TARGET=hip_gicc COMPILER=hipcc_gicc GICC_USE_LTO_PASS=1
